title: Best Pair Sharing a Digit Sum
statement:
You get an array nums of positive integers. The digit sum of a number adds its decimal digits: the digit sum of 472 is 4 + 7 + 2 = 13.

Choose two different indexes i ≠ j whose numbers have the same digit sum. Return the largest possible nums[i] + nums[j], or -1 if no two numbers share a digit sum.

examples.why: 18 and 36 both have digit sum 9 (54). 43 and 7 both have digit sum 7 (50). 13 has no partner.
The digit sums are 1, 3, 10 and 5: all different.
The two largest numbers, 71 and 51, do not match (8 vs 6). The best is 51 + 42 = 93, not 71 + 17 = 88.

hints: Group the numbers by digit sum. Within one group, which pair gives the biggest sum?
The best pair of a group is its two largest members. You never need the others.
One pass: keep, for each digit sum, the largest number seen so far. When a new number arrives, pair it with that stored maximum, then update the maximum.

explain.intuition:
Only numbers with the same digit sum may pair, so think of buckets keyed by digit sum. Inside a bucket the best pair is simply its two largest members.

You do not even need to store the buckets. Keep only the largest number seen for each digit sum. When a new number x arrives and its bucket already has a maximum m, the best pair using x is x + m. Then keep max(m, x). Digit sums are at most 81 for numbers below 10⁹, so this map stays tiny.
steps: Create an empty map best from digit sum to the largest number with that sum.
For each x, compute its digit sum s.
If s is in the map, update the answer with x + best[s].
Set best[s] = max(best[s], x). After the loop return the answer, which starts at -1.
pitfalls: Pairing the two largest numbers overall, or the largest number with any partner. The third example breaks that.
Updating the stored maximum before computing the pair, which would pair x with itself.
Converting to strings in a hot loop is fine in clarity but slower; % 10 and integer division are the usual way.

solutions.title: Check every pair
solutions.idea: Compare the digit sums of all pairs and keep the best total.

solutions.title: Largest per digit sum
solutions.idea: Keep the largest number for every digit sum; each new number pairs with the stored one.

followups: Return the best sum of three numbers that share a digit sum.
Group by any key function, for example the number of set bits. Does the code change?
